hooks.name: vehicle_destroy
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's VehicleDestroyEvent)

rust_summary: a boat or minecart about to be destroyed (`native_vehicle_destroy`).
doc_summary: A boat or minecart is about to be destroyed at `pos`: `native_vehicle_destroy(kind, pos)` is heard just before it is removed; TNT minecarts that prime instead are not heard. Bundles need "hooks": @API:native_vehicle_destroy@.
